name: Single-function arithmetic bug
description: Discount calculation adds discount instead of subtracting.
golden_patch:
--- a/cart.py
+++ b/cart.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def calculate_total(price: float, discount: float) -> float:
     # BUG: adds discount instead of subtracting
-    return price + discount
+    return price - discount
